evidence_for.quote: Final decision: retain the qualified observed cluster reference and recommend no additional empirical allocation now, with the concrete fresh-policy-use revisit above.

evidence_for.quote: Fixed F gives +0.12407302446321236J over C and +0.07674096500501802J over own-dwell on the single freshly C-trained cluster endpoint.
evidence_for.why: 已有真实训练与两个必要比较器，足以保留这个已观察实例上的用途。

evidence_against.quote: One fresh unchanged cluster B is the strongest rejected alternative.
evidence_against.why: 新训练实例确实可能暴露反例；目前接受这一未决风险，并未声称重复没有价值。

evidence_against.quote: The strongest contradiction/limit is useful simple dwell, eight adverse F−dwell worlds, and only one independent training instance.
evidence_against.why: 不能将均值推广为新训练策略稳定受益，也不能把全部收益归因于反向移动。

uncertainty: 未来新训练策略上的收益是否重现未知；64 个评价世界不是64 次独立训练。
